newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel banks not acting in concert - market body.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel banks not acting in concert - market body.

text.p: The CMF French market watchdog said in a statement that the banks of Eurotunnel were not acting in concert and that they did not have to make a mandatory bid for the remainder of the shares.
It said it had studied the financial restructuring documents in which the banks could get up to 769 million Eurotunnel units, or 45.5 percent of the increased sharecapital.

"The council has judged that the measures taken as part of the financial restructuring do not have the characteristics of a concert party action and that in consequence the question on whether or not a mandatory bid must be made is not of the order," it said.
